*Made at every family get-together.*

## Ingredients

- 4 Avocados
- ⅓ onion
- ½ jalapeno
- ¼ cup cilantro
- 1 tbsp mayo
- 2 tsp vinegar
- ½ lemon
- garlic salt
- pepper
- tomatoes (optional)
- stuffed olives (optional)
- cucumbers (optional)

## Instructions

1. Mix and mash all the ingredients together.
